description: Current Argentine dollar quotes (ARS per USD): oficial, blue, bolsa (MEP), contado con liquidacion (CCL), mayorista, cripto and tarjeta, with buy/sell, spread, update time and the blue vs oficial gap. Send {} for all or {casa} for one. Source failure = no charge. Paid tool: 0.002 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].
